description: Reviews a pull request from outside the core team on an open-source Umbraco package: runs the `reviewer` agent, then checks what's unsafe to build locally, security, contribution rules, docs, and whether the diff does what it claims. Drafts the review for approval; never posts or merges on its own. Use for community PRs. For your own task's diff, use `reviewer` through `feature-build` or `quick-fix`.
